title: linum suffruticosum subsp. milletii
intro: Linum suffruticosum subsp. milletii, commonly known as Dwarf Flax, is a plant species in the family Linaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Linum suffruticosum subsp. milletii include wound healing, skin protection, and treatment of gastrointestinal issues, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is required to confirm the specific health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
